"PersianSocks uses Android VPN permission to route app traffic through a proxy. You can disconnect at any time.

SOCKS5 and HTTP do not encrypt the path from your phone to the proxy. HTTPS proxies or TLS-only mode encrypt that path using TLS 1.2 or 1.3. The selected server receives destination addresses and your public IP. Its operator can observe destinations and traffic without encryption to the destination. Public proxy sources are operated by third parties.

Settings, results, usage counters and error reports stay on your phone; reports are not sent automatically. Scans make HTTPS requests to proxy sources and test domains. A requested speed test downloads up to 20 MB from Cloudflare or OVH. IP checks use ipify or AWS. These services see the request exit IP. Installed-app inventory is used locally for Split Tunneling and is not uploaded.

Encryption to the proxy does not itself encrypt the path beyond it. The destination app or website should also use HTTPS or suitable encryption.

By choosing Accept, you agree to route traffic through the selected server as described above."

"PersianSocks uses Android VPN permission to route app traffic through a proxy. You can disconnect at any time.

The Play edition only accepts proxies with valid TLS and encrypts the path to the proxy using TLS 1.2 or 1.3. The selected server receives destination addresses and your public IP. Its operator can observe destinations and traffic without encryption to the destination. Public proxy sources are operated by third parties.

Settings, results, usage counters and error reports stay on your phone; reports are not sent automatically. Scans make HTTPS requests to proxy sources and test domains. A requested speed test downloads up to 20 MB from Cloudflare or OVH. IP checks use ipify or AWS. These services see the request exit IP. Installed-app inventory is used locally for Split Tunneling and is not uploaded.

Encryption to the proxy does not itself encrypt the path beyond it. The destination app or website should also use HTTPS or suitable encryption.

By choosing Accept, you agree to route traffic through the selected server as described above."
